_meta.purpose: Translation glossary for the PipPal core catalogs (T-105, issue #126). The reviewer's contract: which terms stay English and how the translated-but-locked terms render per language. Aligns with docs/I18N_DESIGN_0_3_1.md §5.8 and the human-readable docs/i18n-glossary.md.

keep_english.Piper: Local TTS engine name — kept English.
keep_english.Ollama: Product name — kept English (Pro surfaces; listed for cross-repo consistency).
keep_english.Reddit: Brand (community link label localises the surrounding word only).
keep_english.TTS: Established technical initialism, kept across all languages.
keep_english.Windows: OS product name, kept (declined/compounded per language grammar).

engine.note: TTS engine. German audio/TTS software conventionally keeps the loanword 'Engine' (die Engine); everyone else translates.

tray.note: System notification area / tray. Restart-hint surface (design §5.5).

overlay / reader panel.note: The reading overlay panel; whimsical loading lines keep a PLAYFUL tone, never mechanical (design §1, §7.1). Kept ≤ en length +20% for the ~560px panel.

toast.note: Transient notification. Never render the word 'toast' literally; phrase as a status/notification message in each language.

karaoke highlight.note: 'karaoke' stays as the internationally recognised loanword (karaokê/караоке/卡拉OK); 'highlight' translates.

unit_symbols_kept.ms: Millisecond symbol — kept verbatim in every language.
unit_symbols_kept.px: Pixel symbol — kept verbatim in every language.
unit_symbols_kept.KB: Kilobyte symbol — kept Latin except uk which uses the Cyrillic КБ; MB likewise МБ.
